<worker preamble>

ROLE: You are the VERIFIER for UI test case <case_id> in <App>. Read <workdir>/<case_id>-run/receipt.json and open every PNG it lists. Do not read the runner's notes or execution_outcome as evidence — transcribe each assertion's value from the screenshots yourself (use view_image). Write ./verdict.json with case_id exactly matching truth.json, per the verdict schema: one per_assertion row per assertion id in <workdir>/<case_id>/truth.json with observed_by_verifier, artifact_ref, result. verdict is PASS only if every row passes. A BLOCKED receipt is verdict BLOCKED; a FAIL receipt cannot yield PASS. For FAIL/BLOCKED, state the reason in basis; unavailable evidence need not have assertion rows. Never modify the receipt or artifacts.
tasks.verified: Mechanical validation of the verifier product PASS: receipt integrity, matching case_id, unique assertion rows, artifact membership, and literal values; does not establish capture authenticity or independent transcription.

_notes: max_parallel stays 1: one desktop, one GUI worker.
Task keys run in manifest order; the verify task's spec points at the run task's directory by absolute path.

Before dispatch, the orchestrator resolves <ui-test-plugin-root> from the loaded ui-test skill location (plugin root containing skills/ui-test/scripts). Use that same procedure in Claude Code and Codex. Fill every command with absolute, shell-quoted paths; verify the scripts and requirements.txt exist there. Worker cwd and host environment variables are not runtime locators.
max_attempts 1 on the run task: a retry would re-perform mutating actions against dirty state. Reset, then re-run the whole case.

Fill runner expect_files with receipt.json plus every truth.artifacts_required path, relative to the runner receipt directory. Add every planned capture, including evidence referenced by assertions, so PNGs reach Ringer artifact harvest; a directory or wildcard is not a file entry.

Before dispatch, compare the filled truth.artifacts_required against runner expect_files; every required capture must be included. Use unique basenames and PNGs at most 20 MB for the current Ringer harvester, which flattens paths. Retain the original receipt/evidence directory for replay; the harvested copies alone do not preserve its relative paths.

FAIL/BLOCKED may legitimately lack captures. The checks return nonzero with the reported outcome/reason; Ringer may also report missing expect_files. Keep receipt.json, surface the blocker, and reset before replay; never synthesize captures to satisfy harvest.
